notes.title: Remastered Edition
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that we are now working on a Remastered Edition of the summer Fling story... The new version will include the following contents:

[list]
    [*]A completely re-written and extended story-line
    [*]A third character and extra romance options
    [*]Three Act story that goes beyond the time at the lake house
    [*]More CG scenes and backgrounds for the game
    [*]New Achievements and content to unlock
[/list]

The original version will remain included in the game, but the remastered edition will become the final edition of the game. We hope our existing players will try the game again once the new content is released later in the year.

notes.title: Available Early
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that version 1.0 is now stable and available early for all of our kickstarter backers and helpers along the way.

Thank you for your support.

Version 1.0 includes all the game content, cg scenes, music etc as well as these additional Steam features.
[list]
   [*]Achievements
   [*]Trading Cards
   [*]Cloud Saving
[/list]
For those on the hunt for additional content patches, checkout the community hub for information.
